name: docs_kill_switch
description: Found while building the harness: with EVREN_AUTO_DOCS=false (the documented kill switch) a finished normal-mode task still creates changelog.md in the project, because `append_changelog_entry` never consults `docs_enabled` (only `ensure_project_docs` does). Expected: with the switch off, neither agent.md nor changelog.md is written. Expected to fail until that is fixed; then remove the xfail key.
user_inputs: Merhaba, kısa bir soru: bu proje ne yapıyor?
